title: Global livestock greenhouse gas emissions

source.name: Livestock sector emissions assessment
source.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

notes: Billion tonnes of CO2-equivalent per year. 2015 figure (~6.2 billion tonnes, ~12% of human-caused emissions) is FAO's measured estimate; 2050 figure (~9.1 billion tonnes) is FAO's business-as-usual projection if demand grows with no new mitigation.
